answer: A saffron-coded repair tag binds each agent identity to a verified structural history, like an SRM limit requiring original load-path restoration before sign-off. Each identity must show a rivet-row ridge of countersigned maintenance events, so forging one means fabricating a full traceable chain, costing an attacker far more than minting cheap keys. This zephyr of trust still fails if a colluding shop validates fakes, so cross-shop audit sampling caps the damage.
